name: four-tabs
title: Four tabs: Library, Following, Margins, Settings
summary: Every home gets a name on the tab bar. Following lists what you follow: shows now, friends and clubs later, one row each, sorted by newest with 'N new'; a show is a place you go, so a noisy one never floods anything, and Quiet shows sink to a collapsed group. Following's plus opens its own sheet, Follow a show or a friend; the Library's plus only adds a source. The Library holds items only, one sortable list. Settings becomes a tab, which makes voice, storage and help cheap. The old Following stream and Manage feeds both go away; Quiet and Unfollow live on the Show screen.
shared_fixes: Margins stay grouped by item, with Share beside each item's heading. Groups are ordered by their most recent Margin and that Margin carries a Newest label, so the newest one is in the first group. Inside a group the Margins keep source order. A Margin row plays its moment; its chevron opens its details.
Margin details offer Share this Margin (a one-Margin packet to the share sheet).
Item details show the published date and the date added.
Export all Margins is one toolbar button on the Margins tab that hands a Markdown bundle to the share sheet; the folder export moves under Settings.
Settings is a tab. The Library's options menu is removed; Help lives in Settings.
Clear reproducible audio is a button on Settings itself; Offline Storage keeps the detail.
Unfollow lives on the Show screen with an Undo toast instead of a confirmation alert; no landing tab manages a feed.
Settings sections: Voice, Storage, Notes folder, Import & export (collapsed to two rows), Help, About & legal (collapsed).

screens.title: Library
screens.note: Same place, items only. Gains one in-place sort control: Added, Published, Publisher, Topic. Collections stay.
The Following stream is replaced by the Shows tab.

screens.title: Following
screens.note: Becomes the Following tab: everything you follow, one row each, sorted by newest. Today that is shows, each row with 'N new', the newest episode's title and a play button; later a friend's story and a book club are rows in the same list. Quiet shows in a collapsed group at the bottom (two rows, then Show all). Toolbar plus opens the Follow sheet, not the Library's Add sheet. The tab only lists and plays; Quiet and Unfollow live on the Show screen, so no landing tab manages a feed.

screens.title: Show
screens.note: One followed show: its episodes with dates, play buttons, Quiet toggle, Unfollow. Also the landing after Browse finds a show (Follow lives here).

Becomes the fourth tab. Sections: Voice, Storage (with Clear reproducible audio), Notes folder, Import & export (collapsed to two rows), Help, About & legal (collapsed).
